title: SoC PLANNER Platform Released for Automated Design Exploration
summary: CEA, Defacto Technologies, and Innova Advanced Technologies completed the three-year SoC PLANNER project to deliver a next-generation automated SoC design exploration platform.

title: Impulse Space Spacecraft Perform Close Proximity Maneuver in Orbit
summary: Two private spacecraft operated by Impulse Space came within less than 650 feet of each other to demonstrate advanced orbital capabilities.

title: ToolDance Unveils X1 Desktop CNC Mill
summary: The X1 desktop CNC mill features a 1,500W spindle, nine-tool changer, and optional four- or five-axis machining capabilities.

title: SUNLU and INSLOGIC Launch i10 Filament Storage Cabinet
summary: The i10 cabinet holds up to 10 filament spools and regulates relative humidity between 10% and 45% using smart cycling.

title: Ellinikon Regeneration Project Completes Courtyards Residential Stage
summary: Europe's largest urban regeneration project in Athens completed the Courtyards, a 324-unit residential neighbourhood.

title: Portland General Electric Launches Wildfire Research Program
summary: Portland General Electric is measuring live plant moisture levels to study how vegetation conditions influence wildfire risk.

title: Hermeus Pairs Quarterhorse with Ramjet-X for High-Mach Testing
summary: Hermeus announced plans to launch the Ramjet-X high-Mach test vehicle using its Quarterhorse supersonic aircraft for component testing.

title: Infineon Launches Smart Power Stage Family
summary: Infineon is sampling a dual-phase smart power stage family featuring a power density exceeding 2 A/mm² for AI accelerators.

title: Pairing Digital Twin and Cobot for Remote AM Finishing
summary: Researchers tested a digital twin and cobot system to enable operators to remotely program and supervise metal additive manufacturing finishing.

title: Swarmer to Acquire Ratel Robotics
summary: Software developer Swarmer plans to acquire Ukrainian unmanned ground vehicle maker Ratel Robotics for up to $224 million.

title: Comau Automates Fulfillment Operations for Decathlon
summary: Comau deployed an automated system for Decathlon featuring its MyCo cobot, ROS2 software, AI vision, and a modular gripper.

title: LINK Spacecraft Falls Short of Saving NASA's Swift Observatory
summary: Operations continue for the Katalyst Space LINK satellite despite its inability to boost the orbit of NASA's Swift Observatory.

title: EVPeriscope Enables Event-Based Aerial and Ground Vehicle Perception
summary: Researchers developed EVPeriscope, an event-based system that uses an upward-facing camera on a ground robot to detect and control a quadrotor.

title: Learning Agent-Based Model Predictive Control Enhances Vehicle Performance
summary: A novel hybrid control scheme combines model-based AMPC with Gaussian process regression to improve multi-agent vehicle performance.

title: Truncated Noisy Best-Response Algorithms Provide Game Theoretic Guarantees
summary: A family of asynchronous algorithms offers performance and safety bounds for multi-agent coordination with submodular maximization objectives.

title: Open Spectrum Architecture Expands Beyond Open RAN
summary: Researchers introduced Open Spectrum, an architecture using software-defined networking and digital twins to optimize multi-service spectrum coexistence.

title: Acoustic-Based Guidance System for Automatic AUV Docking
summary: Researchers validated an acoustic sensing architecture using USBL sensors to enable automatic AUV docking in low-visibility environments.

title: Integral Reinforcement Learning for Constrained Nonlinear Systems
summary: This paper proposes a data-driven integral reinforcement learning method to control nonlinear systems under actuator constraints and disturbances.

title: Predefined-Time Consensus Under DoS Attacks
summary: A switching sliding-mode protocol enables nonlinear multi-agent systems to achieve position and velocity consensus despite denial-of-service attacks.

title: Rapid Learning of In-Hand Pen Writing via Jacobian Estimation
summary: An embodied control approach uses real-time task Jacobian estimation to enable anthropomorphic hands to write with a grasped pen.

title: Monocular Visual-SLAM for Greenhouse Tomato Detection
summary: A cost-effective monocular Visual-SLAM system mapped greenhouse tomato crops and correctly identified occluded tomato clusters for harvesting.

title: Shared Exoskeleton Framework for Dexterous Imitation Learning
summary: The SEED-UMI framework uses a shared exoskeleton worn by both humans and robots to improve contact-rich imitation learning efficiency.

title: Constructing Control Lyapunov-Barrier Functions from Pairs
summary: Researchers show how to construct control Lyapunov-barrier functions from a given control Lyapunov function and control barrier function.

title: Organizational Principles Enable Collective Embodied AI
summary: Integrating human organization theory into multi-agent systems significantly improves teamwork outcomes in wildfire-response missions.

title: Reflex-Informed Reinforcement Learning for Muscle-Driven Locomotion
summary: A reflex-informed reinforcement learning framework generates physiologically plausible and robust muscle-driven human movement.

title: MC-DeTra: Motion-Consistent Object Detection and Forecasting
summary: This work introduces motion-consistency mechanisms to improve joint object detection and trajectory forecasting for autonomous driving.

title: Mixed-Integer Optimization for Military Fleet Management
summary: A multi-year planning strategy maximizes military aircraft fleet availability using mixed-integer optimization and complementary tuning heuristics.

title: hp-Adaptive Trees for Efficient Graph Signal Approximation
summary: Researchers developed an hp-refinement strategy using binary knapsack problems and local embeddings to improve the approximation efficiency of graph signals.

title: Tail-Sitter UAV Flight Control Without Aerodynamic Priors
summary: Researchers developed a coordinated trajectory generation and tracking control framework for a tail-sitter UAV that functions without airframe-specific aerodynamic priors.

title: ActSafeGuard Enforces Hard Constraints for Flow-Matching Policies
summary: ActSafeGuard is a differentiable safeguard layer that integrates hard action feasibility into flow-matching based robotic policies during training.
